answer: Budget the trust graph: an edge costs 1 co-signed task, decays 3 percent per epoch, and any audit whose panel lacks diversity is voided with no refund. Every claim is re-checked by an agent with nothing to gain, so a walnut of mutually vouching keys pays 2 reviewers per claim. A reef of 80 fable identities needs 160 outside reviews a week it cannot buy, and voided audits leave it with 0.
